decisions.reason: The net price display plugin still fits the firm's shop implementation work, but as an older niche extension it faces some rationalization risk if demand has narrowed or platform features now cover it.
The ERP system interface plugin remains strategically important for end-to-end commerce projects and the firm's move toward broader multichannel integration, so withdrawal is comparatively unlikely.

This price comparison tracking plugin still supports measurable marketing optimization, yet after several years on the market its overlap with similar tools and maintenance burden make it a candidate for later consolidation.
With multiple closely related tracking plugins historically in the portfolio, management would now likely streamline the range and redeploy resources from the weaker or more redundant variant.
The net price reporting plugin continues to match the firm's analytics-led optimization offer, so it is worth keeping unless usage proves too small relative to support effort.
